Metadata.Goal: 以 EagerDataFlow 与 canonical RunGraph 真正执行、修改和恢复 AIDataWorkflow。
Metadata.Description: 数据 DAG driver、generation facts、GraphPatch、invalidation、run-local reuse 与 tools。

TaskSpace.name: execute-ai-data-workflow-through-eidolon-runtime
TaskSpace.Description: Canonical mutable data workflow runtime over Eidolon effects.

TaskGroup.name: Persistent RunGraph driver
TaskGroup.Description: Persist and apply canonical data graph nodes.

Task.name: Add data graph fact persistence and recovery tests
Task.Description: Save/restore graph plus per-generation state and prove fresh-VM reads.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Graph and generation state survive a fresh runtime service

Task.name: Implement canonical ready-frontier driver
Task.Description: Apply Entry/Transform/Sink/Return/manual nodes using EagerDataFlow code contracts.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Completed and manual-waiting DAGs persist node input/output/config/status

TaskGroup.name: Generation patch and reuse
TaskGroup.Description: Expose correction and deterministic reuse as first-class behavior.

Task.name: Add graph patch and resume tools
Task.Description: Apply validated GraphPatch and resume stable manual node IDs.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Patch history and transitive invalidation are visible through public tools

Task.name: Implement run-local semantic reuse
Task.Description: Fingerprint effective semantics and honor node policy/default/source.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Unchanged semantic-hash nodes reuse prior generation while never nodes rerun

TaskGroup.name: Public runtime and verification
TaskGroup.Description: Adopt data runs in generic tools and verify authority/acceptance.

Task.name: Route generic workflow tools by canonical form
Task.Description: Run/status/events/result/resume dispatch to ctrl or data facts.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Existing public tools expose real data DAG projections

Task.name: Run data runtime verification
Task.Description: Run DAG/patch/reuse/recovery/effect tests and compiled build.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Tests prove canonical semantics and no parallel parser or external CLI path
